$description: FileBrowser (platform/patterns/FileBrowser), library wave 12, lane A: its pattern tokens. The space between the breadcrumbs, the bar and the body; the tree's pane (the line at its end, its padding, its tallest height before it scrolls, the focus ring of its scrolling region); the content's least height (room for the empty state and the drop overlay). The breadcrumbs, the command bar, the tree, the list, the cards and the overlay are their components'.

file-browser-gap.$description: FileBrowser: the space between the breadcrumbs, the bar and the body (space-stack-sm).

file-browser-body-gap.$description: FileBrowser: the gap between the body's parts (space-inline-md).

file-browser-tree-gap.$description: FileBrowser with the tree: the gap between the tree's line and the content (space-inline-md).

file-browser-tree-border-color.$description: FileBrowser: the line at the tree pane's end (border-divider).

file-browser-tree-padding-block.$description: FileBrowser: the tree's padding top and bottom (space-inset-xs).

file-browser-tree-padding-inline.$description: FileBrowser: the space between the tree and its pane's line (space-inset-sm).

file-browser-tree-max-height.$description: FileBrowser: the tree's tallest height; past it the tree scrolls (600px).

file-browser-focus-outline-color.$description: FileBrowser: the focus ring of the tree's scrolling region (focus-ring-color).

file-browser-content-min-height.$description: FileBrowser: the content's least height, room for the empty state and the drop overlay (200px).
